scientific limitations/integrity: Exact finite result for the ten-vertex Petersen graph. The packaged standard-library checker exhausts all 1024 subsets and all 252 five-subsets. The scalar \(Z(P)=5\) is prior work; some high-degree coefficients follow general polynomial theory. The claimed contribution is the complete Petersen enumeration, lower coefficients, and minimum-set type classification. No generalization to other generalized Petersen graphs is asserted, and unindexed prior computation remains a residual originality risk.
title: Zero forcing polynomial and minimum-set types of the Petersen graph
